task: DMG Synth: keep VGM or Code running while a person edits parameters, selects sounds or plays the same physical channels.
implemented: VGM and Code remain mutually exclusive automatic sources. UI and keyboard can coexist with either.
Playing VGM receives manual sparse parameter writes and keyboard triggers on its own four-channel reference APU. No extra APU is allocated for these keys.
CH1–4 use their physical source; Synth round robin uses the current source pool and actual CH1 Sweep restriction. VGM writes may overwrite manual parameters and acquire gate ownership again.
Sparse edits merge against the latest generation-head register shadow. Another field cannot be reverted from an older displayed snapshot.

Older key-ups, Pitch restoration and cleanup do not cut or retune a later VGM trigger. Full preset load updates the authored instrument and reference APU without stopping song transport; delayed forwarding is pinned to the reference run.
Foreground rendering targets 35 ms lookahead using 256-frame segments and an 8 ms refill timer. Automatic UI publication remains capped at 20 Hz. Queued PCM is retained rather than skipped.

Only pending manual fields appear immediately in the UI until their generated timestamp becomes audible. Entries are bounded by field count; coupled Sweep fields use physical period/shift codes. Later VGM writes then become visible again.

Pause retains exact queued PCM and freezes the raw audible snapshot for the existing isolated keyboard audition and Capture. Seek reconstructs the original VGM and clears manual ownership; canceled seek keeps its prior queue/view contract.

Native EOF already generated or APU powered off disables new intervention. The original song duration stays exact. A released Pitch wheel can still reset its software value without a powered-off register write.
Manual Sweep Off clears pace/shift while retaining Direction, avoiding an unintended native negate-clear channel shutoff.

node.includes: Actual WASM combined/manual PCM against independent direct-core render, unchanged VGM PCM, gate ownership, sparse RMW, Wave-only upload, low latency, continuous numeric edits, Sweep toggles, exact Pause/seek/Capture, EOF and power transitions.

finalFocusedRegression.scope: After the last coupled-field display correction; all other C-stage product JS/CSS is byte-identical.

browser.safety: Headless Chromium and WebKit. Gain zero was inserted before application JS; Chromium also used --mute-audio. No ordinary desktop browser or OS volume control was used.
browser.manualEvidence: Recorded manual KON and replacement pitch writes on the same reference engine; finite nonzero mixed PCM measured after its old queue prefix; independent Wave/Noise from silence; no editor-worklet keyboard noteOn during VGM.

statePolicy.playingCHManualEdits: Temporary reference-APU state; original VGM and authored preset unchanged. Pause then Capture to save the combined configured voice.
statePolicy.synthAndPresetEdits: Also update the authored single-instrument preset for Stop and Save.
statePolicy.publicSDK: Unchanged, including generated WASM/native core and JSON schema.

limitations: The short queued prefix introduces software scheduling latency; the foreground target is not a sample-accurate or background timing guarantee.
During VGM playback channel mute also mutes manually played keys on that same reference channel. Paused isolated audition remains independent.
Wave RAM uploads may end CH3; the VGM transport and other channels continue.
